#### 3. Manual compaction command ALREADY IMPLEMENTED - REMOVE FROM BACKLOG (cli + core)

- **What**: Manual compaction (NEW 2026-10-02, carry-forward MEDIUM ~3-4h from yesterday's research) is ALREADY IMPLEMENTED in Alexi. `/compact` slash command exists in `src/cli/interactive.ts` L638-658:
  ```ts
  case 'compact': {
    if (!history || history.length === 0) {
      console.log(c('yellow', '\n  No conversation to compact\n'));
      continue;
    }
    const { result } = await compactConversation(history);
    if (result.compactedMessages < result.originalMessages) {
      console.log(c('green', '\n  Compaction complete:'));
      console.log(c('gray', `  Messages reduced from ${result.originalMessages} to ${result.compactedMessages}`));
    } else {
      console.log(c('yellow', '  No compaction needed'));
    }
  }
  ```
  Imports `compactConversation` from `src/core/compaction.js` L39. TUI also has `partialCompact` in `src/cli/tui/hooks/useRewind.ts` L11-68 (maps MessageDisplay to compaction Message, calls `partialCompact(compactionMessages, turnIndex)`, rebuilds MessageDisplay from compacted). Slash menu lists `/compact` with description "Trigger manual context compaction" L279. Warning at 735: "Warning: Consider running /compact to free up context". Feature complete.

- **Why**: Yesterday's research (2026-10-03) listed manual compaction as NEW MEDIUM ~3-4h (add `/compact` slash command, call `compactConversation`, persist to session). Cline #14770 shipped desktop `/compact` (sidecar manual compaction). **Alexi already has `/compact` in interactive CLI** (L638-658) and `partialCompact` in TUI rewind (L11-68). Feature already shipped. REMOVE from backlog.

#### 4. Prompt draft persistence wiring - SMALL REMAINING WORK (tui)

- **What**: Cline #14645 "fix(desktop): preserve prompt drafts when switching sessions" (NEW 2026-10-02, carry-forward LOW ~2-3h) restores drafts across session switches in desktop app. Alexi has `src/session/draft.ts` (124 lines) implementing in-memory draft cache:
  - `DraftCache` class with get/set/delete/promote methods (L46-103)
  - `DraftCacheStore` interface (L22-27) pluggable backend, default `InMemoryDraftStore` (L29-44) uses `Map<string, string>`
  - Process-global `getDraftCache()` singleton (L113-118)
  - Empty-draft eviction (L64-67 "Empty / whitespace-only values are actively evicted") matching Kilocode `0d2fee251`
  - Promotion evicts cache (L93-97) so cache never survives submit
  BUT persistence is in-memory only (L10-14 "Persistence is deliberately in-memory: Alexi's interactive TUI holds a single process, and cross-process persistence would require a durable store"). Cline #14645 desktop app restores drafts on session switch; Alexi TUI session switches lose drafts because store is in-memory Map. Infrastructure exists (pluggable `DraftCacheStore` interface), just needs wiring into TUI session switch handler to persist/restore drafts.

- **Why**: Alexi TUI (`src/cli/tui/App.tsx` 14084 bytes, `src/cli/tui/pages/ChatPage.tsx`) has session switching but does NOT wire `DraftCache` into session switch handler. User types prompt text, switches to different session, switches back — draft lost because `InMemoryDraftStore` Map is not keyed by session id in TUI. Cline #14645 pattern: store draft on session switch, restore on session re-open. **Alexi already has `DraftCache` infrastructure** (pluggable interface, process-global singleton, empty-draft eviction, promotion contract) — need to wire into TUI session switch handler: `getDraftCache().set(oldSessionId, currentPromptText)` on switch-away, `getDraftCache().get(newSessionId)` on switch-to, restore in prompt component. SMALL ~2-3h: add session switch hook in TUI, call `getDraftCache().set(sessionId, promptText)` on unmount/switch-away (check prompt not empty), call `getDraftCache().get(sessionId)` on mount/switch-to and restore to prompt component state, add tests for draft persistence across session switches, verify `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` green, test in running TUI with session switch + draft recovery.

- **Source**: /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/session/draft.ts (124 lines, `DraftCache` class, `DraftCacheStore` interface, in-memory backend, L10-14 "deliberately in-memory"), https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/14645 (Cline desktop draft persistence, merged before 2026-10-03), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/cli/tui/App.tsx (14084 bytes, TUI main), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/cli/tui/pages/ChatPage.tsx (TUI chat page)

- **Category**: tui (session switch handler, draft save/restore wiring)

- **Size**: SMALL ~2-3h (add session switch hook in TUI `ChatPage.tsx` or `App.tsx` session context, on session switch-away call `getDraftCache().set(oldSessionId, currentPromptText)` if prompt non-empty, on session switch-to call `getDraftCache().get(newSessionId)` and restore to prompt component state via useState/useEffect, handle race: switch-away before draft save completes, add unit tests in `src/cli/tui/__tests__/` for draft save on switch-away, draft restore on switch-to, empty draft not persisted, promotion evicts draft, add integration test with TUI mount + session switch + prompt recovery, verify `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` green, test in running TUI with `alexi chat` + type prompt + switch session + switch back + draft restored)
